note: Clark County Forestry & Parks campground on 28-acre no-wake Snyder Lake near Humbird, with a boat launch and fishing but no beach. The county markets it for camp-and-ride: the ATV trail runs past the campground and every site is open to ATV/UTV traffic. --Claude
summary: County page, map, off-season page and extended-stay policy read; WebTrac unread (refuses). 49 sites (map), electric at all but site 10, showers/flush toilets/dump, $30 ($26 off-season), reservable May-Sep with a 28-night cap, walk-in self-registration Oct-Apr (year-round). OHV FLAG: 'Direct access to the ATV trails from your campsite provides a unique camp and ride opportunity'. PIN MOVE ~740 m: stored point is on the road at the lake's south outlet; loop at ~44.5803,-90.7193. Not waterfront kept. Google 4.5/88.
flags: OHV (reviewer decides): the county page says 'Direct access to the ATV trails from your campsite provides a unique camp and ride opportunity' and 'ATV/UTV Trail Access and all sites are open to traffic'; the map says 'All Sites Available for ATV Camping' and draws the ATV trail along the campground's east edge. It is also a general county lake park (boat launch, shelters, playground, shower house), so it may count as a general campground with an OHV side - flag only.

PIN MOVE (>250 m): stored 44.5735,-90.7210 sits on the county road by the lake's south outlet/bridge, ~740 m from the campground. Target 44.5803,-90.7193 (centre of the campsite loop on Esri imagery, north of the day-use shelters and parking; Google's point 44.5790,-90.7189 is on the day-use side).
SITES: stored count 35 -> 49 per the county map V 19.1 (1-45, 1A, 14A, 23A, 25A). The map is undated; WebTrac (which would list the current sites) refuses.
ELECTRIC: the map underlines site 10 as non-electric while the page says 'NON-Electric Campsites are NOT Available at Snyder'; electric left unset (no amperage posted).
SEASON: year-round with reduced off-season service (Oct-Apr self-registration, water/dump not guaranteed, 'we cannot guarantee access').

WATERFRONT: not waterfront KEPT. The loop's west-side sites (21-38 by the map) sit ~50-60 m from the lake through brush and trees on imagery; no site on open ground at the water, and the county says there is no beach.
LONG-STAY: not a seasonal park - every Snyder site caps a reservation at 28 nights (Extended Stay policy).
